name: Summer Heatwave & Peak Demand
description: High outdoor temperature (34°C max) with intense afternoon solar gain. Tests Optimum Start pre-cooling, SAT reset optimization without causing coil saturation, and optimal dual-chiller staging.

name: Shoulder Season Mild Day
description: Moderate ambient temperatures (14°C to 21°C). High opportunity for aggressive SAT upward reset (up to 17.5°C), coast-down shutdown 45 mins before occupancy ends, and single chiller partial load.

name: Hybrid Work & Erratic Occupancy
description: Sporadic occupancy with 40% building occupancy on Mondays/Fridays. Demonstrates Zone Temperature Deadband expansion and zone-level setback savings.

name: Sensor Fault & Fail-Safe Verification
description: Simulates a drifting VAV damper sensor reporting false 100% cooling demand and a frozen OAT sensor. Demonstrates safety guardrails, rogue zone ignoring, and fallback safe setpoints.
